correctness.rationale: The physical four-state determinant reduces exactly to one translation zero and the stable cubic s^3+g s^2+s+theta g. The real-root parameterization G(r), the derivative and the cubic discriminant are symbolically checked. Their fold locations, conjugate-pair real part alpha(r), and its single extremum establish all optimal branches, their global uniqueness, two thresholds and defective eigenvalue multiplicities. Seeded numerical eigenvalue checks (3,210 comparisons) corroborated the algebra, but continuum claims rely on proof, not sampling. The polynomial factor at a defective optimum is explicitly excluded from any claim of an exact pure exponential estimate.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is the sharp entire-domain optimizer for the rank-one grounded dashpot on an unpinned two-mass spring system, including thresholds 1/9 and 1/5 and unique behavior at triple/double roots. Full-text inspected Dolfo–Vigué explicitly uses anelastic damping and separate onsite springs; the more general Freitas–Lancaster matrix optimization and Arnold–Gendelman–Zharnitsky critical matrices have different admissible damping families. Main–Krenk presents general approximate tuning; no material examined states or implies this exact constrained three-phase classification. Actual topical searches and older mathematical-record comparisons did not uncover a dominating prior claim. This bounded PASS is not a uniqueness/prior-publication certificate; several historical papers remain only abstract-accessible.
residual_risks: Full text of Main–Krenk (2005), Freitas–Lancaster (1999), Cox–Overton (1996), and an earlier 1998 lumped-system energy absorption paper was not inspected: a specialized example or implicit algebraic corollary could duplicate the claim.
The 2026 generic 2-DOF critical-damping preprint was abstract-accessible only; its full derivations may include comparable structured cases.
No literature search or research partition proves worldwide historical priority; originality is assessed relative to actually inspected evidence.

value.rationale: A single local dashpot is physically more restrictive than arbitrary damping matrix optimization. The exact mass ratios 1/8 and 1/4 organize three qualitatively distinct fastest-relaxation mechanisms; one threshold is a triple exceptional point, while the interior optimal regime has equal real parts without a collision. Full necessity, global uniqueness, endpoint behavior and explicit tuning give an actionable and structurally interesting design classification rather than a scalar rescaling.
